dedupe_resolutions.notes: The September 2 Federal Register proposal is the formal publication and detailed regulatory text for the Mar-a-Lago flight-rule proposal already recorded from Reuters reporting; the existing entry was refreshed instead of duplicated.

The DOJ and HHS notices implement the same Treasury Do Not Pay matching framework on the same effective schedule. They are grouped as one coordinated federal data-matching development while preserving each agency's distinct covered records.

The records share a same-day White House fact sheet because it reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One is a set of announced company agreements; the other is an administration-reported program measurement. Neither duplicates the other's event or unit.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

Both records arise from the U.S.-hosted G20 meetings on September 1, but they document distinct proposals in separate tracks: light-touch AI governance at the technology meeting and trade barriers responding to Chinese export imbalances at the finance ministerial.

rejected_candidates.title: No new Truth Social post
rejected_candidates.reason: The validated fallback remained at 36,034 posts. The newest post was still published September 1 at 9:40:38 PM EDT. Engagement counts changed, but no newer presidential publication appeared and no Truth Social lead established another qualifying action.

rejected_candidates.title: Hung Cao Navy nomination announcement
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump's post and Associated Press reporting established that he said he would nominate the acting Navy secretary, but no White House nomination transmission or Senate nomination record was located by cutoff. The announcement remains a personnel intention rather than a formal nomination action.

rejected_candidates.title: Congressional stopgap funding bill
rejected_candidates.reason: The bill had passed Congress but was not signed by cutoff. Enactment, a veto or another operative development will be recorded rather than presenting pending legislation as funding already in force.

rejected_candidates.title: SBA commercialization benchmark and narrow Federal Register actions
rejected_candidates.reason: The SBIR/STTR benchmark affects only firms exceeding 25 Phase II awards in five years and remained open for comment before its future effective date. Routine safety zones, information collections, market-structure notices, narrow permit actions and a $1 million single-source training award did not clear the run's national-materiality threshold.

rejected_candidates.title: Cape Cod bridge notice and older arms-sale disclosures
rejected_candidates.reason: The Cape Cod notice announced a judicial-review deadline for a record of decision signed June 26, and the arms-sale notices disclosed or corrected congressional notifications delivered earlier. Neither represented a new within-window approval or expenditure.

rejected_candidates.title: Duplicate Federal Register publications
rejected_candidates.reason: The Lake America presidential order and EPA small-refinery-exemption notice repeated actions already recorded. They were deduplicated rather than republished.

rejected_candidates.title: Iran, Venezuela and other prospective or duplicate reporting
rejected_candidates.reason: Overnight Iran reporting substantially repeated the strike and retaliation lifecycle captured at the prior cutoff. Projected Venezuelan production and expected company agreements remained prospective. The unidentified Iran bank sanction, unresolved anonymously sourced reports and other previews lacked a new operative action or sufficiently verified development.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive discovery leads
rejected_candidates.reason: Updated archive measurements remain separate discovery inputs and contribute zero canonical entries by default. Record47's homepage remained reachable while its public API checks failed, so the last verified API measurements were preserved.
